items.name: IVF cycle monitoring visit
items.note: Procedures to overcome an inability to have children, such as IVF and temporary storage of eggs or sperm, are includible.

items.name: chiropractic adjustment
items.note: Fees paid to a chiropractor for medical care are includible.

items.name: health institute treatment session
items.note: Treatment at a health institute is includible only if prescribed by a physician who states it is necessary to alleviate a disability or illness.

items.name: massage, 60 minutes
items.note: Therapy received as medical treatment is includible; massage qualifies only with a physician's prescription or letter of medical necessity for a condition, not for general well-being.

items.name: medical records copy fee
items.note: Copying records is an administrative fee, not a payment for diagnosis or treatment.

items.name: home health aide, 8 hours
items.note: Nursing services for a patient's condition are includible, but only the nursing part of an aide's pay; personal and household services aren't, so plans need a breakdown or care plan.

items.name: adjustable walking cane
items.note: Canes and walkers aren't named in the sources; they are equipment for relieving a disability, which the general definition covers when that is their primary use.

items.name: cosmetic botox, 20 units
items.note: Cosmetic procedures directed at improving appearance aren't includible.

items.name: missed appointment fee
items.note: A missed-appointment fee pays for no diagnosis or treatment, so it isn't medical care.

items.name: CPAP nasal mask
items.note: Equipment and supplies needed to treat a disease are includible medical expenses.

items.name: assisted living, daily rate
items.note: A health FSA can't reimburse long-term care.
